description: Capaian Pembelajaran (learning outcomes) per subject and phase for every level: PAUD (Fase Fondasi), the general subjects of SD/MI, SMP/MTs, SMA/MA, SMK/MAK and Paket A/B/C, the SMK programme subjects, the kesetaraan muatan, special education (SDLB/SMPLB/SMALB and the Program Kebutuhan Khusus, incl. Fase Fondasi for TKLB), and the madrasah subjects (RA, Al-Qur'an Hadis, Akidah Akhlak, Fikih, SKI, Bahasa Arab, MAPK). Per subject: Rasional, Tujuan, Karakteristik, the element table (with sub-elements where printed) and the CP per phase and element, with source pages. One gzip JSON file per appendix plus index.json (subjects, phases, grades per phase).
status: ready without religion: Pendidikan Agama dan Budi Pekerti (Kepka BKPDM 020/2026, scanned) follows in a checked second step (F-032)
source: Kepka BSKAP 046/H/KR/2025 Lampiran I–V (2025-07-16) and SK Dirjen Pendis 9941/2025 (2025-11-28). Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/capaian-pembelajaran/
procedure: python3 -I tools/converters/capaian-pembelajaran.py sources/capaian-pembelajaran data (about 2 minutes; pdftotext and pdfplumber). Text is extracted from the PDFs' text layer, not retyped: prose and CP from pdftotext -layout, element tables with pdfplumber. The converter stops on any structure problem (missing part, empty phase, unreadable heading), cuts off the signature block and refuses NIP-like numbers. Checked after the build: 2,426 of 2,426 non-empty outcome texts and 2,167 of 2,181 element-description sentences occur verbatim (letters and digits) in the PDF text of their pages; the rest are table cells split by a page break and match on inspection. Differences between element-table names and CP headings are source facts, kept per subject in source_notes. Printed errors the document resolves itself are listed in each file's errata (F-031). Version = date of the newest source (SK 9941/2025). The religion CP of 046 (Lampiran II I.1–I.6, Lampiran V I.1–I.6) is left out because Kepka BKPDM 020/2026 replaced it.

format.index.json: subjects[]: file, key, title, number, phases, levels (the levels the appendix covers), source; phases: grades per phase; totals
format.<file>.json.gz: subjects[]: key, title, title_printed, number (number_printed when corrected), pages, levels, source, rasional, tujuan, karakteristik, elements[{name, sub_element?, description}], phases[{phase, applies_to (as printed), page, intro, outcomes[{element, sub_element?, text, page, no_cp?}]}], source_notes?; errata[]; pending (religion) where it applies. Text keeps list items and labels on their own line (\n).
